relations.subject: ButtonOnOff
relations.evidence: ButtonOnOff is an on/off interaction element on the front panel; typical function is machine power control.

relations.subject: ButtonLightCoffee
relations.evidence: ButtonLightCoffee is labeled and placed with other coffee selection buttons; CoffeeSimulation1 is a coffee particle system positioned at the outlet.

relations.subject: ButtonStrongCoffee
relations.evidence: ButtonStrongCoffee appears as a coffee selection; CoffeeSimulation2 exists as alternate coffee output.

relations.subject: ButtonTwoLightCoffees
relations.evidence: ButtonTwoLightCoffees indicates two-cup action; likely triggers the coffee simulation for two servings.

relations.subject: HotWaterButton
relations.evidence: HotWaterButton is colocated with steam/hot-water UI; SteamOutlet components (steam pipe) are on front-right.

relations.subject: SteamButton
relations.evidence: SteamButton visually matches steam control and is adjacent to steam outlet components.

relations.subject: LeftOutlet
relations.evidence: LeftOutlet is positioned directly above/near the cup location in multiple views and has geometry consistent with a liquid outlet.

relations.subject: RightOutlet
relations.evidence: RightOutlet is another dispensing nozzle aligned to cup area (side view shows nozzle facing cup).

relations.subject: WaterReservoir
relations.evidence: WaterReservoir is a dedicated reservoir component located at machine rear; CoffeeSimulations represent fluid output, implying supply relation.

relations.subject: CollectingPan
relations.evidence: Cup is located on the collecting pan in front views; strong projection and contact evidence.

relations.subject: SteamPipe
relations.evidence: SteamPipe is a child of SteamOutlet in scene hierarchy.

clusters.name: DeviceBody
clusters.rationale: Primary structural parts forming the device exterior and top assembly.

clusters.name: ControlPanel_UI
clusters.rationale: Controls, buttons and display grouped as the user interface cluster on the front panel.

clusters.name: DispensingAssembly
clusters.rationale: Nozzles, pipes and holders used to deliver coffee, hot water and steam.

clusters.name: CollectingPanAssembly
clusters.rationale: Components around the drip/collecting pan and related covers.

clusters.name: CupAssembly
clusters.rationale: Cup placed in the tray for receiving beverage; treated as its own logical object.

clusters.name: CupWarmerAssembly
clusters.rationale: Top plate assembly likely intended to warm cups.

clusters.name: SimulationEffects
clusters.rationale: Particle systems and visualization elements representing coffee flow and visuals.

diagnostics.message: Many interactive elements (buttons) have empty interactionParams. Interaction axes/ranges are unspecified.
Several objects lack colliders even though they are interactive (buttons, outlets). Add colliders if physical interaction is required.
Some child objects have roles empty (e.g., Outlets, SteamOutlet). Roles inferred for UI and dispensing objects in clusters but not present on all nodes.
CoffeeSimulation particle systems are present (CoffeeSimulation1/2) and CoffeePlane (visualization). These are visualization-only and do not have explicit physical attachment states.
World AABB missing for multiple high-level objects (CoffeeMachine2, Case, many subnodes). Exact global bounding boxes absent.
